parole.significato: bombast; cotton or cotton wool (raw fibers of cotton before being processed.)
parole.testo: Borrowed from German Bombast (“bombast”), from English bombast, from Old French bombace (“cotton, cotton wadding”), from Late Latin bombax (“cotton”), a variant of bombyx (“silkworm”), from Ancient Greek βόμβυξ (bómbux, “silkworm”), of Anatolian origin. Cognate with English bombast and German Bombas

parole.significato: bombastic, pompous, grandiloquent; inflated or pretentious in style or expression.
